description: Add a website to the signed-in user's Connecty status page (HTTPS only, up to 5 sites). The full URL, including path and query parameters, becomes public on the status page and in public results, so do not add URLs with tokens, secrets, or signatures. Connecty checks it right away and then once a day at 08:00 UTC. Returns the new site with its first result and the updated list. Requires sign-in with permission to change sites.

url.description: The website's public HTTPS URL, e.g. https://example.com. The full URL becomes public; do not include access tokens, signatures, or other secrets.

name: add_site
title: Add a site
